CC.scope: Direct extension clauses inventoried; incorporated OAuth and core authorization requirements are tracked dependencies, pending exhaustive clause review.

EMA.scope: Direct extension clauses inventoried; incorporated OAuth and core authorization requirements are tracked dependencies, pending exhaustive clause review.

IDJAG.scope: Pinned draft-04 text SHA-256; incorporated clause inventory pending. Client exchange and helper profiles only; IdP/AS policy remains host-owned.

TASKS.scope: Initial named regression requirements; official server checks are gated separately. Complete clause/schema mapping and client interop inventory remain pending.

CORE.scope: Core prose and schema trees are monitored, including new revisions. Existing core conformance remains separate; comprehensive clause-level register expansion is pending.

cc.no_anonymous.asserts: A CC token request is never sent without client authentication, even if none is advertised.

cc.no_dcr.asserts: A CC-only flow with no pre-registration sends neither registration nor token request.

cc.jwt_algorithm.asserts: Full flow rejects ES256 when only RS256 is advertised, before sending an assertion.

cc.discovery_algorithm.asserts: Dedicated discovery rejects a JWT signing algorithm the AS did not advertise.

cc.basic.asserts: Pre-registered Basic credentials are sent only in Authorization; resource and configured scope are included.

idjag.valid.asserts: A signed ID-JAG with correct audience and resource validates.

idjag.audience.asserts: A signed ID-JAG addressed to a different AS is rejected.

idjag.resource.asserts: A signed ID-JAG for a different MCP resource is rejected.

idjag.signature.asserts: An ID-JAG signed by an untrusted key is rejected.

assertion.valid.asserts: Builder signs a JWT; signature verifies and decoded iss/sub/aud and exp/iat/jti shapes are inspected. This case alone does not test verifier rejection.

ema.as.explicit.client_secret_basic.asserts: explicit enterprise orchestrator authenticates the AS leg using client_secret_basic, with separate IdP credentials and resource binding.

ema.as.explicit.client_secret_post.asserts: explicit enterprise orchestrator authenticates the AS leg using client_secret_post, with separate IdP credentials and resource binding.

ema.as.explicit.private_key_jwt.asserts: explicit enterprise orchestrator authenticates the AS leg using private_key_jwt, with separate IdP credentials and resource binding.

ema.subject.explicit.refresh.asserts: explicit orchestrator checks the refresh subject-token profile or input conflict before token exchange.

ema.subject.explicit.saml.asserts: explicit orchestrator checks the saml subject-token profile or input conflict before token exchange.

ema.subject.explicit.conflict.asserts: explicit orchestrator checks the conflict subject-token profile or input conflict before token exchange.

ema.as.explicit.mismatch.asserts: A mismatched AS client identifier fails before either token leg.

ema.as.discovery.client_secret_basic.asserts: discovery enterprise orchestrator authenticates the AS leg using client_secret_basic, with separate IdP credentials and resource binding.

ema.as.discovery.client_secret_post.asserts: discovery enterprise orchestrator authenticates the AS leg using client_secret_post, with separate IdP credentials and resource binding.

ema.as.discovery.private_key_jwt.asserts: discovery enterprise orchestrator authenticates the AS leg using private_key_jwt, with separate IdP credentials and resource binding.

ema.subject.discovery.refresh.asserts: discovery orchestrator checks the refresh subject-token profile or input conflict before token exchange.

ema.subject.discovery.saml.asserts: discovery orchestrator checks the saml subject-token profile or input conflict before token exchange.

ema.subject.discovery.conflict.asserts: discovery orchestrator checks the conflict subject-token profile or input conflict before token exchange.

ema.as.discovery.mismatch.asserts: A mismatched AS client identifier fails before either token leg.

ema.discovery.profile.asserts: An explicit profile list excluding ID-JAG fails before registration or either token leg.

ema.subject.saml_response.asserts: Wrong issued_token_type on SAML transition is rejected before AS grant.

idjag.resource.optional.asserts: Explicit if_present accepts absence, without null claim.

idjag.resource.optional_wrong.asserts: A present wrong resource remains rejected.

idjag.resource.handler.asserts: Handler propagates explicit resource policy and preserves absence.

idjag.resource.config.asserts: Trusted expected resource and a known policy remain necessary.

peer.cc.full.jwt.asserts: Node jose verifies client assertion signature, client identity, known AS audience, expiry and unique jti before issuing a resource-bound token; resource peer validates that token.

peer.cc.dedicated.jwt.asserts: Node jose verifies client assertion signature, client identity, known AS audience, expiry and unique jti before issuing a resource-bound token; resource peer validates that token.

peer.ema.explicit.id_token.asserts: Verifying Node IdP and AS complete the selected subject-token sequence, independently validate JWTs and enforce issuer/client/resource binding before resource access. SAML assertion itself is an opaque test token, not XML validation.

peer.ema.explicit.refresh_token.asserts: Verifying Node IdP and AS complete the selected subject-token sequence, independently validate JWTs and enforce issuer/client/resource binding before resource access. SAML assertion itself is an opaque test token, not XML validation.

peer.ema.explicit.saml2.asserts: Verifying Node IdP and AS complete the selected subject-token sequence, independently validate JWTs and enforce issuer/client/resource binding before resource access. SAML assertion itself is an opaque test token, not XML validation.

peer.ema.discovery.id_token.asserts: Verifying Node IdP and AS complete the selected subject-token sequence, independently validate JWTs and enforce issuer/client/resource binding before resource access. SAML assertion itself is an opaque test token, not XML validation.

peer.ema.discovery.refresh_token.asserts: Verifying Node IdP and AS complete the selected subject-token sequence, independently validate JWTs and enforce issuer/client/resource binding before resource access. SAML assertion itself is an opaque test token, not XML validation.

peer.ema.discovery.saml2.asserts: Verifying Node IdP and AS complete the selected subject-token sequence, independently validate JWTs and enforce issuer/client/resource binding before resource access. SAML assertion itself is an opaque test token, not XML validation.

sdk.auth.jwt.asserts: Pinned TypeScript SDK 2.4.0 Auth helpers call Elixir HTTP peers; Arbor validates SDK credentials/claims and issues ID-JAG for the enterprise helper. Loopback fetch mapping, not vendor AS certification or full SDK transport qualification.

sdk.auth.basic.asserts: Pinned TypeScript SDK 2.4.0 Auth helpers call Elixir HTTP peers; Arbor validates SDK credentials/claims and issues ID-JAG for the enterprise helper. Loopback fetch mapping, not vendor AS certification or full SDK transport qualification.

sdk.auth.enterprise.asserts: Pinned TypeScript SDK 2.4.0 Auth helpers call Elixir HTTP peers; Arbor validates SDK credentials/claims and issues ID-JAG for the enterprise helper. Loopback fetch mapping, not vendor AS certification or full SDK transport qualification.

ema.discovery.publisher.asserts: Configured ID-JAG profile is emitted by AS metadata helper.

ema.exchange.token_type.asserts: An IdP access token is rejected before forwarding to resource AS.

ema.exchange.missing_type.asserts: An ID-JAG response without issued_token_type is rejected.

ema.exchange.bearer_type.asserts: An ID-JAG response with Bearer token_type is rejected.

ema.exchange.missing_token_type.asserts: An ID-JAG response omitting token_type is rejected before the AS grant.

ema.discovery.grants.asserts: An explicit grant list excluding JWT bearer cannot be overridden by a profile indicator.

cc.resource_mismatch.asserts: Dedicated discovery rejects a caller resource that disagrees with discovered PRM, before token request.

assertion.verify.valid.asserts: Verifier accepts a valid client assertion.

assertion.verify.audience.asserts: Verifier rejects a different AS audience.

assertion.verify.key.asserts: Verifier rejects a wrong signing key.

ema.cimd.supported.asserts: A valid CIMD URL with AS support retains CIMD registration classification.

ema.cimd.unsupported.asserts: CIMD registration cannot bypass missing AS support.

ema.cimd.invalid_url.asserts: CIMD registration cannot use a non-URL client identifier.

tasks.ttl.null.asserts: Client validator accepts required nullable ttlMs.

tasks.http.name.asserts: All three task HTTP methods emit taskId in Mcp-Name.

tasks.errors.dispatch.asserts: Unknown task IDs yield invalid-params through dispatch.

tasks.errors.http.asserts: Unknown task IDs yield invalid-params through HTTP processing.

tasks.input.unique.asserts: Input request keys cannot be reused for another logical request in the task lifetime.

tasks.failure.pending_input.asserts: A task awaiting input can record a protocol failure and become failed.

cc.discovery.secret.empty.asserts: Dedicated client credentials discovery rejects a empty secret before any token POST.

cc.discovery.secret.nil.asserts: Dedicated client credentials discovery rejects a nil secret before any token POST.

ema.explicit.grants.asserts: Explicit enterprise flow rejects contradictory discovered grants before either token leg.

ema.explicit.profile.asserts: Explicit enterprise flow rejects contradictory discovered profile before either token leg.

peer.ema.key_separation.asserts: Independent IdP and AS have distinct registration keys; using the IdP key at the AS cannot issue or access a resource token.

peer.cc.bad_key.asserts: Independent AS rejects a client-credentials assertion signed by an unrelated key before issuing a token.

requirements.requirement: An adopted extension inherits the extension and core authorization requirements.
requirements.notes: Core and incorporated-reference inventories are not yet exhaustive; no full-compliance claim.

requirements.requirement: Client credentials are pre-registered; DCR is not used.
requirements.notes: Authorization-code DCR remains separate.

requirements.requirement: Client credentials requests authenticate using a client secret or JWT.
requirements.notes: POST is supported as a configured secret method; AS metadata has separate obligations.

requirements.requirement: JWT authentication uses the client-assertion type and signed assertion profile.
requirements.notes: Builder and verifier contracts plus configured Node/jose and SDK interop cases are separate. Execution artifacts prove passes; complete inherited RFC clause inventory remains pending.

requirements.requirement: Select an interoperable advertised signing algorithm before sending an assertion.
requirements.notes: Client negotiation check; the explicit metadata MUST belongs to the AS.

requirements.requirement: Supporting AS metadata advertises private_key_jwt or client_secret_basic.
requirements.notes: Metadata helper is configurable; it does not implement a complete token-issuing AS.

requirements.requirement: An AS supporting JWT authentication publishes signing algorithms.
requirements.notes: Host must configure and enforce its advertised methods and algorithms.

requirements.requirement: Discover the resource AS and obtain a resource-bound token before authenticated MCP use.
requirements.notes: Local token-flow coverage is not complete transport-level interop.

requirements.requirement: Protect credentials, tokens, storage and communications.
requirements.notes: Cross-cutting dependencies need separate requirement expansion and deployment policy.

requirements.requirement: Obtain the initial identity assertion from the configured enterprise IdP.
requirements.notes: Host owns initial login, SAML validation, registration and administrator policy.

requirements.requirement: Exchange the identity assertion for an ID-JAG with audience equal to the resource-AS issuer.
requirements.notes: Named positive and negative exchange cases are being added.

requirements.requirement: Authenticate the exchange when the IdP registration requires authentication.
requirements.notes: Optional issuer-bound Basic/POST/JWT exists; register its executable evidence and independent peer.

requirements.requirement: Support the selected subject-token profile, including the SAML-to-refresh-token transition.
requirements.notes: Initial SAML SSO, XML signature validation and IdP mapping policy remain host-owned.

requirements.requirement: A present resource identifies the MCP server.
requirements.notes: Resource absent is a separate explicitly configured profile.

requirements.requirement: The profile permits an ID-JAG resource claim to be absent.
requirements.notes: Default remains strict. Host still enforces resource-restricted token issuance.

requirements.requirement: Validate signature, audience, expiry, typed header and required ID-JAG claims.
requirements.notes: Full incorporated claim inventory, tenant policy and replay handling must be classified separately.

requirements.requirement: Present the ID-JAG as a JWT bearer grant and authenticate with the resource-AS registration.
requirements.notes: Optional as_auth Basic/POST/JWT has explicit issuer/client/endpoint bindings; legacy behavior retained when absent.

requirements.requirement: A non-preregistered client can use a configured metadata document identifier.
requirements.notes: Explicit as_auth CIMD retains AS-support and URL checks. A complete independent CIMD document-fetch/registration qualification is still pending.

requirements.requirement: Apply enterprise trust policy and issue a token restricted to the authorized MCP resource.
requirements.notes: The grant helper does not provide token issuance, SAML policy or a complete OAuth AS.

requirements.requirement: Recognize the ID-JAG authorization_grant_profiles_supported indicator.
requirements.notes: Discovered profile and grant contradictions fail before either token leg. Explicit host-selected endpoints have no metadata to contradict; older metadata may omit the optional profile indicator.

requirements.requirement: Bind issuer, subject, client and tenant to the appropriate trusted registration.
requirements.notes: Host registration/policy responsibility; helpers alone do not qualify a multi-tenant AS.

requirements.requirement: Process token responses and OAuth errors without substituting another issuer or credential.
requirements.notes: Wrong or missing issued token type and wrong/null token_type are rejected before forwarding. Broader OAuth error and issuer/credential-separation cases remain under inventory expansion.

requirements.requirement: Accept nullable ttlMs while preserving its required wire field.
requirements.notes: Initial scoped requirement evidence; not a complete Tasks specification qualification.

requirements.requirement: Mirror taskId in the required request routing header.
requirements.notes: Initial scoped requirement evidence; not a complete Tasks specification qualification.

requirements.requirement: Return invalid-params for unknown task identifiers without disclosing ownership.
requirements.notes: Initial scoped requirement evidence; not a complete Tasks specification qualification.

requirements.requirement: Keep input request keys unique throughout the task lifetime.
requirements.notes: Initial scoped requirement evidence; not a complete Tasks specification qualification.

requirements.requirement: Represent execution errors as a failed task, including while input is outstanding.
requirements.notes: Initial scoped requirement evidence; not a complete Tasks specification qualification.
